chunks: Narrated to us Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Attar (may God have mercy on him), who said: Narrated to us Saad ibn Abdullah, who said: Narrated to us Abd al-Samad ibn Muhammad, who said: Narrated to us Hanan ibn Sadir, who said: Narrated to us Sudayf al-Makki, who said: Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir (peace be upon him) narrated to me -- and I never saw any Muhammadan who equaled him -- he said: Narrated to us Jabir ibn Abdullah al-Ansari, who said: The Messenger of God (may God bless him and his family) addressed us in a sermon and said:

O people, whoever hates us, the Ahl al-Bayt, God will raise him on the Day of Resurrection as a Jew. He [Jabir] said: I said, O Messenger of God, even if he fasts, prays, and claims to be a Muslim? He said: Even if he fasts, prays, and claims to be a Muslim.

key_terms.أبغضنا أهل البيت: abghadana ahl al-bayt -- whoever harbors hatred toward the Prophet's household
key_terms.بعثه الله يوم القيامة يهوديا: ba'athahu Allahu yawm al-qiyamah yahudiyyan -- God will resurrect him on Judgment Day as a Jew

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad say about those who hate the Ahl al-Bayt on the Day of Resurrection?
ai.summary: The Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) gave a sermon saying: O people, whoever hates us, the Ahl al-Bayt, God will raise him on the Day of Resurrection as a Jew. Jabir asked: O Messenger of God, even if he fasts, prays, and claims to be a Muslim? The Prophet replied: Even if he fasts, prays, and claims to be a Muslim. This hadith, narrated through Imam al-Baqir from Jabir ibn Abdullah al-Ansari, establishes the fundamental link between love for the Ahl al-Bayt and the validity of one's Islam.
word_analysis: may He have mercy on him
